name: Kindread: The Redburns
source:
You are the only guy in a small group in the midst of the zombie apocalypse.
As your attraction to the others has grown, so has your libido and boldness. Unfortunately, no-one else seems to share your desires and, except for a recent act of bravery, your actions now find you in danger of being expelled from the group.
